articles.summary: The combined company, Clywedog Therapeutics, will bring a portfolio that includes three differentiated, clinical stage product candidates which are being studied for the prevention/reversal of Type 1 and Type 2 Diabetes and the treatment of Celiac Disease.
articles.title: Barinthus Biotherapeutics to Combine with Clywedog Therapeutics to Target Metabolic and Autoimmune Diseases
